title: Complete your order
description: Review the package, enter your in-game account details, then pay from your wallet balance.
offerPromise: Pay from your wallet balance and we deliver straight to your game account.

summary.title: Order summary
summary.totalHint: The final amount is calculated on the server the moment you confirm.
summary.insufficientDescription: You need {amount} more to place this order. Add balance, then try again.

fields.title: Your in-game account details
fields.description: These are the details the supplier uses to deliver. Check every character: they cannot be changed once the order is placed, and anything delivered to the wrong account cannot be recovered.
fields.noFieldsTitle: This package needs no extra details
fields.noFieldsDescription: Place the order and your code appears on the order page once it is delivered.
fields.lockedNotice: On confirmation the amount leaves your wallet and these details are sent to the supplier as they are.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in and try again.
errors.suspended: This account is suspended and cannot place orders. Please contact support.
errors.unavailable: This package is no longer available. Browse the other packages we have.
errors.insufficient_balance: Your wallet balance does not cover this order. Add balance, then try again.
errors.in_progress: An order with these same details is already being placed. Check My orders before trying again.
errors.invalid_fields: Check the required account details, then try again.
errors.unknown: We could not place this order. Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.

orders.title: My orders
orders.description: Every order with its status, amount, and delivery details.
orders.emptyDescription: Start from the games catalog and pick your first package.

orderDetail.title: Order details
orderDetail.accountDescription: These were sent to the supplier exactly as they are.
orderDetail.noAccountFields: This package needed no extra details.
orderDetail.codesDescription: Keep these somewhere safe; they stay available on this page.
orderDetail.pendingDescription: We have your order and delivery starts shortly. Refresh to follow the status.
orderDetail.processingDescription: The supplier is working on this order and it can take a few minutes. Refresh to follow the status.
orderDetail.completedDescription: This order reached your account. If you cannot find it, contact support with the order number.
orderDetail.failedTitle: This order could not be delivered
orderDetail.failedDescription: The supplier could not complete this order.
orderDetail.refundedDescription: Delivery failed, so the full amount went back to your wallet balance. You will find it in your wallet history.
orderDetail.failedNotRefundedDescription: Delivery failed and the amount has not been returned automatically yet. Contact support with the order number and we will settle it.
